description: This file contains helper functions for managing Kubernetes services, including source range parsing, health check configuration, finalizer checks, load balancer status comparison, and patching services.

methods.name: IsAllowAll
methods.description: Checks if the IPNet set allows traffic from 0.0.0.0/0.

methods.name: GetLoadBalancerSourceRanges
methods.description: Parses and verifies the LoadBalancerSourceRanges field or annotation from a service, returning the set of source IP ranges.

methods.name: GetServiceHealthCheckPathPort
methods.description: Returns the health check path and node port for a service if health checks are needed.

methods.name: RequestsOnlyLocalTraffic
methods.description: Checks if a service requests OnlyLocal traffic based on its ExternalTrafficPolicy.

methods.name: NeedsHealthCheck
methods.description: Determines if a service requires health checks based on its type.

methods.name: HasLBFinalizer
methods.description: Checks if a service contains the load balancer cleanup finalizer.

methods.name: LoadBalancerStatusEqual
methods.description: Compares two load balancer statuses for equality.

methods.name: PatchService
methods.description: Patches a Kubernetes service's status or metadata based on differences between old and new service objects.
